page.layout: One page: a marbled endpaper (pastedown) filling the whole scan. No printed text, no column, no margin text.
page.notes: The scan shows only a marbled paper endpaper in red, blue-grey, ochre and cream. No printed words, page numbers, running heads or signatures are visible. The blue background at the right edge and the dark book edge at the left are the digitiser's backing and the book board, not printed matter.
